titles.title: Black Place I

description: Rippling gray and black hills expand across the canvas. A jagged valley running through the center of the composition divides the hills. At the bottom of the work, red and tan strata add a pop of color to the landscape.
imageCaption: Image has not been color proofed to current standards, and its colors may differ from the original work. The Museum will replace it when new photography becomes available.
